target.title: feat(whatsapp): add throttled progress messages
target.body:
## What Problem This Solves

WhatsApp cannot edit already-sent messages, so long-running turns can look idle even when lifecycle status reactions are enabled. Users who ask for work that takes more than a short moment, such as tool calls, searches, command execution, or code edits, need a low-noise way to see that OpenClaw is still working.

## Why This Change Was Made

This adds an opt-in `channels.whatsapp.progressMessages` config surface for sparse text progress messages during long WhatsApp turns. The runtime waits for the configured initial delay, throttles additional progress messages, caps the number per turn, and cancels pending progress as soon as the final reply starts so progress never races the answer.

The feature is disabled by default to preserve existing WhatsApp message cadence. It complements lifecycle status reactions instead of replacing them.

## User Impact

Operators can enable long-running WhatsApp progress updates without switching to noisy block streaming:

```json5
{
  channels: {
    whatsapp: {
      progressMessages: {
        enabled: true,
        initialDelayMs: 30000,
        intervalMs: 45000,
        maxMessages: 3,
      },
    },
  },
}
```

Per-account overrides are available at `channels.whatsapp.accounts.<id>.progressMessages`.

## Evidence

- `node scripts/run-vitest.mjs src/config/zod-schema.providers-whatsapp.test.ts extensions/whatsapp/src/auto-reply/monitor/inbound-dispatch.test.ts`
  - runtime config shard: 14 tests passed
  - WhatsApp extension shard: 56 tests passed
- `npx pnpm@11.2.2 check:bundled-channel-config-metadata`
- `npx pnpm@11.2.2 format:docs:check -- docs/channels/whatsapp.md`
- `git diff --check`
- `npx pnpm@11.2.2 exec oxfmt --check src/config/zod-schema.providers-whatsapp.ts src/config/zod-schema.providers-whatsapp.test.ts extensions/whatsapp/src/auto-reply/monitor/inbound-dispatch.ts extensions/whatsapp/src/auto-reply/monitor/inbound-dispatch.test.ts src/config/bundled-channel-config-metadata.generated.ts`

Attempted `npx pnpm@11.2.2 check:changed -- ...`; the normal Testbox delegation failed because the local `crabbox` binary failed its basic sanity check. A local child-mode retry proceeded through guardrails and core typecheck, then stalled for several minutes in `tsgo:core:test`, so it was stopped.
